Package aor.proj3t.util.converterutils

Class ConverterFactory

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.util.converterutils.ConverterFactory
@ApplicationScoped public class ConverterFactory extends Object
Factory class to access all entity-DTO converters. This class provides a centralized access point for all the converters in the application. It follows the Factory design pattern to encapsulate the instantiation logic of converters and provides a clean, consistent API for accessing them. The factory is injected with all available converters and offers type-safe methods to retrieve them.

Example usage: 

 UserDTO userDto = converterFactory.forUser().toDTO(userEntity);
 User userEntity = converterFactory.forUser().toEntity(userDto);

      public Converter<User,UserDTO> forUser()
      Gets the converter for User entities and DTOs. This method provides access to the converter responsible for transforming between User entities and UserDTO data transfer objects. The returned converter handles all user-related conversion operations.
